meta.title: Add the technical round (RFP): configurations.bid_start_time has the wrong type

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a technical (RFP) round to the event, exactly as the journey does, with the bid start time sent as "not-a-number".
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event still has no round (nothing was added).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event still has no round (nothing was added).

plan.title: Add the technical round (RFP): configurations.bid_start_time has the wrong type

act.say: The buyer adds a technical (RFP) round to the event, exactly as the journey does, with the bid start time sent as "not-a-number".

assert.say: the event still has no round (nothing was added)
